node.statement: Using the bounds from node 1.2, for nonzero X approximate associativity yields ||(U bold-dot V) bold-dot X-U bold-dot(V bold-dot X)||<=epsilon*||U||*||V||*||X||<=4*epsilon*||X||, whereas ||U bold-dot(V bold-dot X)||>||X||/16. Since epsilon<1/200, ||(U bold-dot V) bold-dot X||>(1/16-4*epsilon)||X||>0. Thus L_{U bold-dot V} is injective, hence bijective in finite dimension, and surjectivity at J supplies an exact right inverse.
